chase: Get close and I'll lock on. No looking required.
Keep running, please. You're doing wonderfully, honestly.
Oh, you're running! Good. Faster is more fun for both of us.
I'm picking up speed now. Can you feel the air change behind you?
Still chasing? Good. My second wind has arrived right on time.
The longer you run, the faster I get. That's the whole deal.
One more corner, same hallway. You can't shake me that easily.
Left, right, left again. I still think I'm faster than your turns.
Hallway run! My favorite kind. Keep your feet moving, friend.
I'll cut the corner short and beat you to the door.
Sprint! Sprint! Okay, I'm sprinting too. Race you to the end.
Don't look back. Looking back slows you down. Trust me on that.
You stopped moving. Nice try. I'm still coming, though.
Almost there. Almost. One more hallway and I've got you.
Round the bend, through the arch, and there you are.
One lap. Then I'm coming for you. Get ready, runner.
I'm flying low now. Don't look up, it's rude.
Round the corner, down the hall. Watch me!
You're running so nicely. Keep it up, please!
catch: Caught you! Oh, that was a good one. Let's do it again.
Got you! Okay, sorry, I'm a little too happy about that.
Gotcha! Hold still, this is the best part of the whole game.
Caught! You can wiggle, but only a little. Rules are rules.
Hold on, I've got your sleeve. Don't pull away now.
Nope, you're mine now. Come along, quick quick.
Got you by the arm. Back to the lounge we go.
One lap and then you're taken. Sorry, that's how the game works.
Tag, you're it! Okay, that was way too easy.
Pinned! Pinned is not the same as stopped. Watch me work.
Easy catch. Too easy, honestly. Try harder next time.
Nice grab, whoever got them. Good work, team, keep it up.
Count that one. Two for me, zero for you.
Taken! Right, let's get you moving before the others come.
Got one! Remember that move, it's my new favorite.
Hold still, I'm only dragging you a little. Promise.
Got you, got you! Oh, that was perfect!
Caught! Sorry, you're heavier than you look!
Hooray, I caught you. Don't squirm too much!
hear: Did somebody just knock something over? I'm on it.
Footsteps! Left or right? Left. Definitely left.
A door just clicked. I'm going to take a look.
That shout came from upstairs. Coming in fast.
Something broke in the next room. Loud, too. Yes.
Ooh, a noise. Noises are the best part of the hunt.
I heard you. Don't pretend you didn't make a sound.
Someone's moving on the stairwell. Heading over now.
That creak sounded new. Let me check, quick as a wink.
Hush, everybody. I think that came from the lounge.
A rattle in the vent? Could be you. Could be nothing.
Tap, tap, tap. Someone's at the window. Off I go.
Hey, you're loud. Good. It helps me find you.
Noise over there. I'm flying over to see what it is.
Did you hear that? I definitely heard that. Going.
Bump! Left side of the stairs. Checking now!
A window squeaked open. Who opened it?
I heard a cupboard creak! Going to look!
search: Lost you for a second. I'll find you again, don't worry.
You lost me in the stairwell. I'll be back for a rematch.
You slipped past me by one step. Fine. That round is yours.
Ha, you slipped me! Next time I'll be faster, just watch.
Lose me for a moment and I'll pick up the trail again.
Where did you go? Come on, don't make me look twice.
Hmm, nothing here. Nothing there. Where are you hiding?
No trail, no sound, no fun. Back to looking, then.
Gone quiet. Quiet is boring. Let's go looking again.
Fine, I'll walk the loop and check every corner again.
Okay, back to patrol. Eyes open, corners checked twice.
Still nothing. I'll wander back to the lounge and wait.
Where'd you go? I'll give it one more lap, then.
I lost the trail near the arch. Let's start over there.
Okay, you win this one. I'm going back to wandering.
stunned: Ow, that hit my wings! Give me one second.
Okay, my head is buzzing. Shaking it off now.
Whoa, that stung. Give me a moment to find which way is up.
My butterfly wings are all wobbly. I can't fly like this.
Hit me hard. Good hit, though. Really good.
Hold on, I'm dizzy. The whole room is spinning a little.
I'm not stunned. I'm sitting very still on purpose.
Ugh, my lenses are all fuzzy now. Give me a moment.
Nice swing. Can I catch my breath before the rematch?
One more hit like that and I'll need a long nap.
I'm fine, I'm fine. Keep your distance while I recover.
Shaking it off. Shake, shake, okay, back in the game.
My legs forgot their job for a second. They're back now.
Ouch! Okay, ouch. Moving again, look at me go.
You can't hold me. I'll wiggle right out of this.
Let go! I'm not finished with this game yet, sorry.
hide_spot: Stay hidden and I can't lock on. Those are the rules, sadly.
Under the desk again? Nice spot. I'll check there first.
Vent again? Smart. I'll check the grate first.
Locker door? Cute. I'll rattle it and see who answers.
Under the bed is a classic. I'm coming to check anyway.
Behind the cabinet? Cute. Let me check the other side too.
Pretending to be a coat rack? Good try. I'm checking anyway.
Hide all you like. I'll still check every spot in the room.
Stay still in there. I'm walking past, slowly, slowly.
Those curtains won't stop me. Curtains never do.
Nice closet. Very cozy. I'd still like to take a look.
I'm walking right past your spot. Hope you held your breath.
Every hiding spot is the same to me. Close is close.
Behind the boxes? Okay, I'll peek over the top.
Hush now. I'm checking every corner of this bed.
You picked the stuffed chair. Bold. Sit still and I'll pass.
light: Your flashlight just swept over me. Rude, but I'll allow it.
Turn that flashlight away, please. I'm trying to fly straight.
Ooh, a bright flashlight. Everything past it is just white.
That flashlight is so bright. My lenses are going to hate it.
Lamp in my face! Ugh, I'm squinting in the whole room.
Okay, that's blinding. Can you point that somewhere else?
Bright light, bright light. My lenses are full of sparkles now.
Watch the lenses, please. They're very expensive lenses.
Blinded for a second. Good thing I know this hallway by heart.
Who keeps shining that? I'm dazzled and a little annoyed.
Lamp too close. Please, I'm trying to look cool here.
Oh, a spotlight! Everybody look at me. Actually, not everybody.
Ugh, bright. I'd rather be in the dark, thanks.
Light in my face makes me squint. Rude, but fine.
Flashlight beam on the stairs. Cute trick. Still coming.
You're shining right at me. Fine, I'll dodge it.
idle: One more go? Please? Just one more round, then.
Button mashing is a skill, and I'm very good at it.
Tokens, quarters, whatever. I only need one more round.
Sitting still is hard. Does a stool count as sitting?
Warm-up round first. Then the real one. Then the one after that.
Ready for the next level? I was born ready, obviously.
No thinking, all button, all fun. That's my whole style.
The old cabinet hums when I walk past. It likes me, I think.
Anybody want to play? I'll go easy. Mostly easy.
High score board in the corner. Mine is still up there.
Nobody has beaten my oldest high score. Nobody has tried.
A quick round before dinner clears my head. Best thinking I do.
Okay, I'll stop bouncing. Maybe. Give it two seconds.
Patrol time! Corridor, corner, corridor, corner. Repeat forever.
Nothing going on. That's fine. I'll make my own excitement.
I love a quiet hallway. Great place to practice my spins.
ability: I don't need sight or sound. Close enough, and I'm locked on.
Exposed runners are easier to lock onto. Sorry, that's just the rule.
Every second of chase makes me quicker. That's the whole trick.
My speed climbs the longer the chase keeps going. Simple, really.
I take off after a short chase. Wings out, floor left behind.
Flying only works where there's room overhead. Otherwise, I walk.
Chase me long enough and I'll almost be a blur.
Stop running and my speed resets. Then I'm just strolling along.
The more exposed you are, the wider my lock gets. Good luck.
Lock on, speed up, never look back. That's the routine.
A short chase and my wings start buzzing. Here we go.
No sight needed, no sound needed. Just distance and nerve.
A grab means I land. Flying is for the open hallways.
I only need to be close. Everything else is extra fun.
The longer I'm in the air, the more fun it gets.
mechanic: Doorway ahead. I'll land and squeeze through. Don't get comfy.
Land at the doorway, fly in the open hall. Good plan, right?
I won't lose you on the stairs. The stairs are my favorite part.
Someone take the stairs. I'll go round by the kitchens, it's quicker.
Low doorways mean I have to land first. Rude, but true.
Batteries first, then the relay. Lovely order for a race.
Grab the battery, then head for the relay. I'll be waiting.
Vents are tight. My wings do not enjoy vents much.
Radar pinged. Good for you. Now I know where to look.
Ledge drop! Nope. Flying only goes so far down.
Who knocked out that fuse? I'm checking every switch now.
Somebody left a door open. Easy in, easy out.
Shutting doors is cute. Give me a second to land.
Stairs are quicker than the long way round. Obviously.
Two batteries is a party, honestly. Bring snacks.
Relay's on the rafters, so I'll fetch it!
Batteries are in the hangar. Hurry, please!
The vent is open. I can squeeze right through!
